review.summary: The three requested fixes are present and complete in the supplied diff. I found no concrete high-severity or critical issue in the two files.

checks.detail: validatedJsonResult is inside the generation try/catch, and its GeminiError schema failure maps to ExplainAnswerError(SCHEMA_INVALID). The study chat schema requires a user-first, strictly alternating history.

The explain prompt marks the full payload untrusted and identifies option status markers as the sole correctness signal. Study chat documents client-supplied history as unverified and demotes all history entries in its system prompt.
Explain generation failures are normalized to ExplainAnswerError with a classified reason. Study chat explicitly fails when Gemini is unconfigured and propagates provider errors.
The study chat request schema bounds message count and length, validates roles and optional unitId, and enforces thread shape. Explain response fields are validated with bounded Zod schemas.
The documented trust model, prompt instructions, and structural history checks are present in the supplied files.
No caller-breaking change is evident in the supplied diff; the study chat result retains usage, model, and prompt version fields.
No test files or test changes were included in the supplied diff, so test coverage cannot be verified from this review. The requested fixes are directly observable in the implementation.
The trust boundaries and validation rules are named and documented clearly; no concrete dead code or needless complexity was identified.
